judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking sky with dramatic dark-to-bright contrast and a colorful halo, though the blown-out sun and heavy processing keep it from being fully refined.
strengths: dramatic contrast between dark cloud mass and bright sun
iridescent halo/rainbow effect around the sun
weaknesses: sun area is heavily blown out
colors and contrast look somewhat overprocessed
foreground silhouette is very dark and lacks detail
